effect_description_eng: [On Play] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, you may play 1 [Hina Kurihara] from your hand without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has an [On Play] effect, it gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
